register.labelZh: DIE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: die away 可以表示聲音慢慢消失;die down 則可以表示噪音逐漸減弱。；die back 和 die down 可以表示植物的葉和莖在冬天枯死,但泥土下面的部分仍然存活。；die off 描述群體中的許多成員相繼死亡;die out 則描述整個物種、語言或習俗完全消失。；這些表達可用來談論動物、植物、傳統、聲音、天氣、情緒和公眾活動。
register.summaryEn: Die away can show that a sound slowly disappears, while die down can show that noise becomes less strong. Die back and die down can describe plants losing their leaves and stems in winter while remaining alive below the ground. Die off describes many members of a group dying, whereas die out describes a whole species, language or custom disappearing. These expressions are useful when talking about animals, plants, traditions, sounds, weather, feelings and public events.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；die away 主要表示聲音逐漸減弱,直至聽不見。die down 表示某事物逐漸減弱,但不一定完全消失。；die off 表示一個群體中的許多成員相繼死亡。die out 表示整個物種、語言、習俗或活動完全消失。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Die away is mainly used when a sound becomes weaker until it cannot be heard. Die down means that something becomes less strong, but it may not disappear completely. Die off means that many members of a group die. Die out means that a whole species, language, custom or activity disappears completely.
